description: UNAVAILABLE: Merges the two drugs' contrasts on gene_name only (a cartesian product over doses, lines and plates) and compares padj across families. A paired comparison verb arrives in phase 3.; use functional_genomics.query_drug_perturbation. Compare transcriptomic signatures between two drugs.

cell_line_id.description: Accepts depmap_cell_line; resolved to one depmap_cell_line (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

concentration.description: Results are per concentration; pass one value, or the call fails with incomplete_key when several apply.

concentration_unit.description: Results are per concentration_unit; pass one value, or the call fails with incomplete_key when several apply.

drug_a.description: Accepts tahoe_drug; resolved to one tahoe_drug (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

drug_b.description: Accepts tahoe_drug; resolved to one tahoe_drug (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

plate.description: Results are listed per plate; pass one value to restrict them.
